messages.subject: Don't show error messages
parts:
Hi,

Is there any way to prevent Shiny from showing error messages? While I change some of sliders I have the whole system recalculating its values and then some error messages are shown. While it finishes recalculating everything is ok again. I have tried options("show.error.messages"=FALSE) but it hasn't worked in Shiny (but it worked in RStudio). Thanks in advance for any help in this issue.

Kind Regards,

Michal

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: Don't show error messages
parts:
Michal,

You can avoid these error messages being shown by modifying your script inside shinyServer.

For example, if you have a reactive output foo that is dependent on the value of an input element named bar, you can modify your code as shown below. The basic idea is to check if the input variable is set and execute the reactive function only if it is. This will avoid the errors you are talking about.

output$bar <- reactive({
  if (is.null(input$foo)) {
    return()
  }
  ## rest of your code
})
